note: Third-party copy-protection loader ("RawCopy PC TSR Patch", Micro Systems International, 1992-93) -- not Renegade/Bitmap Brothers code. Imported as raw binary with image base 0010:0000 (segment 0x10 = linear 0x100, matching real COM-file PSP-relative loading) so Ghidra CALL/JMP-resolved addresses line up directly with file offsets. See docs/launcher.md.

functions.name: entry
functions.summary: Runs Copy_ScanMemoryForSignature; on failure shows Copy_ShowVendorNoticeScreen; on success falls into Sys_HookInt21hAndRunGame.

functions.name: Copy_ScanMemoryForSignature
functions.summary: Scans memory segments (up to 0xa000) via REPNE SCASB for a marker byte, then calls Copy_AppendMatchedString to verify a following string. Likely anti-debugger/anti-monitor scan, not disk-based.

functions.name: Copy_AppendMatchedString
functions.summary: REP MOVSB-copies a length-prefixed entry to the match location if non-empty; returns success/failure via carry flag.

functions.name: Copy_ShowVendorNoticeScreen
functions.summary: Paints a BIOS-text-mode box displaying the vendor identification strings (RawCopy PC TSR Patch, Micro Systems International, address/phone/fax) -- the failure-path notice screen.

functions.name: Sys_HookInt21hAndRunGame
functions.summary: Saves the original INT21h vector, installs Int21_ProtectionHook, resizes memory, EXECs pockets.exe, waits, restores the vector, and terminates.

functions.name: Video_SetRomFont8x16
functions.summary: Loads the ROM 8x16 font (INT10 AH=11h) to guarantee standard 25-line text mode before Copy_ShowVendorNoticeScreen paints.
